description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface and wraps Android's native Log utility to allow flexible logging chains. It provides methods to set and get the next Logger node, and to print log messages with optional exception details, forwarding logs to linked nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implements LogNode, and enables chaining of log nodes to facilitate flexible logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the linked list to forward log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the provided message and optional exception, then forwards the log to the next node if available.
